message.content:
A vertical magazine cover features a red background with a large black "TEMPO" logo at the top. An illustration of a man dominates the left side. He has a beard and mustache, wears a skullcap, and is dressed in a light gray long-sleeved tunic and matching cropped trousers with geometric fold lines. He stands barefoot, his body angled right, with his right fist raised and his left fist at his side.

Across the top, white text reads "TARIK-ULUR RUU PEMILU / KETUA MUI SOAL ‘KRIMINALISASI’ ULAMA". On the right, white and black text states "LIPUTAN KHUSUS MUSLIM KONSERVATIF SALEH ATAU SALAH?". Below the logo, smaller black text says "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU".

The bottom right corner includes a white box with a barcode, the number "00017," and "9 770126 427302." Small red text above it lists "19-25 JUNI 2017," "RP 45.000," "WWW.TEMPO.CO," "MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN," and "ISSN: 0126 - 4273." A dark red horizontal band lines the bottom edge.
